_doc: arrange_windows (QuipMacApp.handleArrangeWindows): LayoutMode.from(arrangeLayout:) then LayoutCalculator.calculate (QuipMac/Models/LayoutPreset.swift), then each normalized rect scaled into the target rect (NormalizedRect.toCGRect(in:)). input: layout (horizontal|vertical), windowCount (how many enabled windows), targetRect {x,y,width,height} in top-left-origin screen pixels. The Mac passes the FULL frame of the primary display (WindowManager.cgFrame(for:)), menu bar and Dock included, not a work area; the Windows host passes its own choice (spec 5.2), and these vectors hold only the math. expect: mode (columns for horizontal = side by side, rows for vertical = stacked), normalized: the 0-1 rects in window order, rects: the same rects in target-rect pixels (unrounded; a host may round to +-1 px). windowCount 0 gives no rects (the Mac sends an error 'No enabled windows to arrange' instead). Expected values are written by the Swift test (QUIP_WRITE_VECTORS=1), never by hand.
